sql: SELECT 'inventory' source,product_id,NULL mth,SUM(qty) qty FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id UNION ALL SELECT 'minimum',product_id,CAST(qty_minimum AS TEXT),qty_purchase FROM product_minimums UNION ALL SELECT 'budget',product_id,mth,qty FROM monthly_budget ORDER BY product_id,source,mth

SELECT 'sales' source,MIN(mth) start,MAX(mth) end,COUNT(*) n FROM monthly_sales UNION ALL SELECT 'budget',MIN(mth),MAX(mth),COUNT(*) FROM monthly_budget UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase',MIN(purchased),MAX(purchased),COUNT(*) FROM purchases

WITH RECURSIVE months(n,mth) AS (SELECT 1,'2019-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT n+1,date(mth,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE n<12), seed AS (SELECT m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase,COALESCE(SUM(i.qty),0) initial FROM product_minimums m LEFT JOIN inventory i ON m.product_id=i.product_id GROUP BY m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase), needs AS (SELECT s.*,m.n,m.mth,COALESCE(b.qty,0) demand FROM seed s CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND m.mth=b.mth), sim(product_id,n,mth,qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,demand,opening,pre_end,replenish,ending) AS (SELECT product_id,0,'2018-12-01',qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,0,initial,initial,0,initial FROM seed UNION ALL SELECT s.product_id,b.n,b.mth,s.qty_minimum,s.qty_purchase,s.initial,b.demand,s.ending,s.ending-b.demand,CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END,s.ending-b.demand+CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END FROM sim s JOIN needs b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND b.n=s.n+1), ranked AS (SELECT product_id,mth,ABS(ending-qty_minimum) absolute_difference,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(ending-qty_minimum),mth) rn FROM sim WHERE n>0) SELECT * FROM sim ORDER BY product_id,n

WITH RECURSIVE months(n,mth) AS (SELECT 1,'2019-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT n+1,date(mth,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE n<12), seed AS (SELECT m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase,COALESCE(SUM(i.qty),0) initial FROM product_minimums m LEFT JOIN inventory i ON m.product_id=i.product_id GROUP BY m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase), needs AS (SELECT s.*,m.n,m.mth,COALESCE(b.qty,0) demand FROM seed s CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND m.mth=b.mth), sim(product_id,n,mth,qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,demand,opening,pre_end,replenish,ending) AS (SELECT product_id,0,'2018-12-01',qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,0,initial,initial,0,initial FROM seed UNION ALL SELECT s.product_id,b.n,b.mth,s.qty_minimum,s.qty_purchase,s.initial,b.demand,s.ending,s.ending-b.demand,CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END,s.ending-b.demand+CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END FROM sim s JOIN needs b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND b.n=s.n+1), ranked AS (SELECT product_id,mth,ABS(ending-qty_minimum) absolute_difference,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(ending-qty_minimum),mth) rn FROM sim WHERE n>0) SELECT product_id,MIN(ending) smallest_end,SUM(demand) total_demand,SUM(replenish) total_purchase,MAX(CASE WHEN n=12 THEN ending END) ending12,MAX(initial)-SUM(demand)+SUM(replenish) conserved_end FROM sim GROUP BY product_id

WITH RECURSIVE months(n,mth) AS (SELECT 1,'2019-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT n+1,date(mth,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE n<12), seed AS (SELECT m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase,COALESCE(SUM(i.qty),0) initial FROM product_minimums m LEFT JOIN inventory i ON m.product_id=i.product_id GROUP BY m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase), needs AS (SELECT s.*,m.n,m.mth,COALESCE(b.qty,0) demand FROM seed s CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND m.mth=b.mth), sim(product_id,n,mth,qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,demand,opening,pre_end,replenish,ending) AS (SELECT product_id,0,'2018-12-01',qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,0,initial,initial,0,initial FROM seed UNION ALL SELECT s.product_id,b.n,b.mth,s.qty_minimum,s.qty_purchase,s.initial,b.demand,s.ending,s.ending-b.demand,CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END,s.ending-b.demand+CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END FROM sim s JOIN needs b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND b.n=s.n+1), ranked AS (SELECT product_id,mth,ABS(ending-qty_minimum) absolute_difference,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(ending-qty_minimum),mth) rn FROM sim WHERE n>0) SELECT product_id,absolute_difference,COUNT(*) ties,GROUP_CONCAT(mth) months FROM ranked WHERE (product_id,absolute_difference) IN(SELECT product_id,MIN(absolute_difference) FROM ranked GROUP BY product_id) GROUP BY product_id,absolute_difference

WITH RECURSIVE months(n,mth) AS (SELECT 1,'2019-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT n+1,date(mth,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE n<12), seed AS (SELECT m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase,COALESCE(SUM(i.qty),0) initial FROM product_minimums m LEFT JOIN inventory i ON m.product_id=i.product_id GROUP BY m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase), needs AS (SELECT s.*,m.n,m.mth,COALESCE(b.qty,0) demand FROM seed s CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND m.mth=b.mth), sim(product_id,n,mth,qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,demand,opening,pre_end,replenish,ending) AS (SELECT product_id,0,'2018-12-01',qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,0,initial,initial,0,initial FROM seed UNION ALL SELECT s.product_id,b.n,b.mth,s.qty_minimum,s.qty_purchase,s.initial,b.demand,s.ending,s.ending-b.demand,CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END,s.ending-b.demand+CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END FROM sim s JOIN needs b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND b.n=s.n+1), ranked AS (SELECT product_id,mth,ABS(ending-qty_minimum) absolute_difference,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(ending-qty_minimum),mth) rn FROM sim WHERE n>0) SELECT product_id,mth AS month,absolute_difference FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY product_id

SELECT m.product_id,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM inventory WHERE product_id=m.product_id) inventory,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM purchases WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND purchased<'2019-01-01') purchases_all,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM monthly_sales WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND mth<'2019-01-01') sales_all,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM purchases WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND purchased>='2018-01-01') purchases_2018,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM monthly_sales WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND mth>='2018-01-01') sales_2018,(SELECT qty FROM monthly_sales WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND mth='2018-12-01') sales_dec,(SELECT qty FROM monthly_budget WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND mth='2018-12-01') budget_dec FROM product_minimums m

WITH RECURSIVE seeds AS (SELECT m.*, 'snapshot' kind,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM inventory WHERE product_id=m.product_id) init FROM product_minimums m UNION ALL SELECT m.*,'purchases_minus_sales',(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM purchases WHERE product_id=m.product_id)-(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM monthly_sales WHERE product_id=m.product_id) FROM product_minimums m UNION ALL SELECT m.*,'2018_purchases_minus_sales',(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM purchases WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND purchased>='2018-01-01')-(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM monthly_sales WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND mth>='2018-01-01') FROM product_minimums m UNION ALL SELECT m.*,'dec_purchase_stock',(SELECT SUM(i.qty) FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.product_id=m.product_id AND p.purchased>='2018-12-01') FROM product_minimums m), modes(mode) AS (VALUES('immediate_add'),('delayed_add'),('immediate_set'),('delayed_set'),('immediate_topup'),('inclusive_add')), demand_year(y) AS(VALUES(2019),(2018)), rec(product_id,kind,mode,y,n,mn,pq,ending,pre) AS (SELECT s.product_id,s.kind,m.mode,y.y,0,s.qty_minimum,s.qty_purchase,s.init,s.init FROM seeds s CROSS JOIN modes m CROSS JOIN demand_year y UNION ALL SELECT r.product_id,r.kind,r.mode,r.y,r.n+1,r.mn,r.pq,CASE r.mode WHEN 'immediate_add' THEN r.ending-b.qty+CASE WHEN r.ending-b.qty<r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE 0 END WHEN 'delayed_add' THEN r.ending+CASE WHEN r.ending<r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE 0 END-b.qty WHEN 'immediate_set' THEN CASE WHEN r.ending-b.qty<r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE r.ending-b.qty END WHEN 'delayed_set' THEN CASE WHEN r.ending<r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE r.ending END-b.qty WHEN 'immediate_topup' THEN MAX(r.mn,r.ending-b.qty) WHEN 'inclusive_add' THEN r.ending-b.qty+CASE WHEN r.ending-b.qty<=r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE 0 END END,r.ending-b.qty FROM rec r JOIN monthly_budget b ON r.product_id=b.product_id AND b.mth=printf('%d-%02d-01',r.y,r.n+1) WHERE n<12), allmetric AS(SELECT *,ABS(ending-mn) diff,'post' metric FROM rec WHERE n>0 UNION ALL SELECT *,ABS(pre-mn),'pre' FROM rec WHERE n>0), ranked AS(SELECT *,MIN(diff) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id,kind,mode,y,metric) mindiff FROM allmetric) SELECT product_id,kind,mode,y,metric,mindiff,GROUP_CONCAT(n) months FROM ranked WHERE diff=mindiff GROUP BY product_id,kind,mode,y,metric ORDER BY product_id,kind,mode,y,metric

WITH RECURSIVE
init AS (
  SELECT pm.product_id, it.qty AS inv, pm.qty_minimum AS mn, pm.qty_purchase AS pq
  FROM product_minimums pm
  JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id) it
    ON it.product_id = pm.product_id
),
rec(product_id, mth, ending, mn, pq) AS (
  SELECT i.product_id, mb.mth,
         CASE WHEN i.inv - mb.qty < i.mn THEN i.inv - mb.qty + i.pq ELSE i.inv - mb.qty END,
         i.mn, i.pq
  FROM init i
  JOIN monthly_budget mb ON mb.product_id = i.product_id AND mb.mth = '2019-01-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.product_id, date(r.mth, '+1 month'),
         CASE WHEN r.ending - mb.qty < r.mn THEN r.ending - mb.qty + r.pq ELSE r.ending - mb.qty END,
         r.mn, r.pq
  FROM rec r
  JOIN monthly_budget mb ON mb.product_id = r.product_id AND mb.mth = date(r.mth, '+1 month')
  WHERE r.mth < '2019-12-01'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT r.product_id,
         r.mth AS "month",
         ABS(r.ending - r.mn) AS abs_diff,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.product_id ORDER BY ABS(r.ending - r.mn) ASC, r.mth ASC) AS rn
  FROM rec r
)
SELECT product_id, "month", abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id;
